limitations: Conditional transfer of reference intrinsics, distortion, wrist roll/axial placement, fixture scale.
Color/scale grooves and template cap centers are heuristic image evidence, not ground truth.
A static CAD pad cannot reproduce tissue deformation; PSM2 uses retained LND surrogate CAD.
Wrist XY offsets are conditional on inherited optical roll and axial placement; a static cap cannot distinguish those freedoms.
A 5mm pad-height prior and a conservative wrist-head-above-slit-plane barrier prevent buried-tool depth degeneracy; neither is measured contact evidence.
Depth and metric accuracy remain unvalidated; inspect all four actual mesh overlays.
